title: Motion-safe iconography and contrast tuning for quickstart onboarding
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Scope: Accessibility and dark-mode pass focused on quickstart/onboarding UX assets, including: product screenshots used in the quickstart, primary onboarding micro-illustrations, CTA and step icons, and short motion microinteractions. Goals: (1) achieve WCAG AA minimum contrast for all text and iconography across light and dark themes, (2) ensure icon legibility at 16px and 24px by revising stroke weights and negative-space, (3) reduce motion intensity on onboarding microinteractions and provide ‘motion-safe’ alternatives, and (4) update docs/screenshots to match final tokens.

Non-goals: Full redesign of onboarding flow, changes to instructional copy, or refactor of global icon system beyond the scoped tokens listed below.

Scope artifacts: link to design brief and asset checklist in Confluence and Drive below.
acceptance_criteria: All onboarding icons meet a minimum contrast ratio of 3:1 against their background at their smallest rendered size (16px where applicable)
Primary title and step text in quickstart screenshots meet WCAG AA (4.5:1) on both light and dark themes
Motion alternatives provided: reduced-motion-friendly GIFs/MP4s + static PNG fallbacks captured at representative frames
QA visual regression tests added to CI capturing both themes and mobile widths (320px, 375px, 768px)
Design tokens (foreground/background/hover) and updated icons merged to repo and referenced in quickstart docs
decisions_log: 2025-11-05: Chosen contrast targets: 4.5:1 for body/title text, 3:1 minimum for decorative icons at small sizes (aligns with guidance for non-text contrast where icon conveys non-critical information)
2025-11-06: Icon stroke weights increased by +0.5px for 16px variants and +0.25px for 24px variants to prevent stroke collapse on low-DPI devices
2025-11-08: Dark theme base background token set to #0F1724; primary icon token set to #E6EEF8 for 4.6:1 on primary containers
2025-11-10: Motion intensity capped to 250ms for onboarding microanimations; provided reduced-motion CSS media-query fallback and static keyframe capture images for docs
review_comments: PM (Riley Chen) 2025-11-09: Confirmed prioritization for hosted quickstart screens over enterprise-only flows — small chance of breaking copy if screenshots change

Engineering (Samira Ortega) 2025-11-11: Requested token names to follow runtime token naming convention (token.onboard.bg-dark, token.onboard.icon-primary) and noted potential overlap with console tokens — action: align tokens with ENG-3892
Accessibility review (Marcus Li) 2025-11-12: Asked for automated contrast checks in CI and manual validation on Windows high-contrast mode — added to QA checklist
Design review (Nina Gomez) 2025-11-15: Approved iconography tweaks, requested a second pass on onboarding stepper dots to ensure hit-target contrast for assistive tech
qa_checks: Automated contrast checks added to visual-tests job: compare computed contrast ratios for tokens and rendered icons (PR #12345)
Manual cross-platform check list: macOS (Retina), macOS non-Retina, Windows 11 default scaling, Android Chrome at 3x DPR, iPhone 12 Safari
Reduced-motion validation: test with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and default animated flows
Screenshot update checklist: capture 3 sizes (desktop 1366x768, tablet 768x1024, mobile 375x812) in both light and dark themes
next_steps: Finish final export of icon sprite sheet and 16/24px standalone SVGs (by 2025-11-17)
Push token changes and icon assets to webapp repo and open PR (PR #12345) — assigned to ENG-3892
Update quickstart docs screenshots and replace existing PNGs in /docs/assets/onboarding/ — coordinate with Docs team
